# Steady Drop — first playable
User approved Swift + SpriteKit and direct Xcode development. Original iOS physics puzzle inspired by observed mechanics, without original branding/assets/code. English, Japanese, Korean; other languages fall back to English. Portrait iPhone, iOS 17+.
20 initial deterministic layouts. Levels 1–10 are forgiving, introducing height and asymmetric removal; 11–20 gradually add height, narrower landing pads and offset supports. Tap wooden blocks to remove; polygon character falls and rotates; camera follows; stay on landing pad at low speed for 1 second to win, fall outside to lose. Retry, next, level selection, persisted unlocks, pause, haptics and language settings.
SwiftUI HUD and menus, SpriteKit physics, vector-drawn original artwork. Native approach selected over Unity/Godot for iOS scope. Working title and visual design are assistant choices. Ads: availability-gated protocol only; no ad network SDK, tracking, fake rewards or live ads. Distribution, ad credentials, consent SDK, signing, privacy policy and App Store submission remain future release work.
